t: The Hager Sollysta WMPB2/28 2-gang surface pattress box provides a reliable enclosure for electrical wiring accessories. With a 28mm internal depth, this double back box is suitable for installing switches and sockets in both domestic and commercial environments. Constructed from durable plastic, it offers convenient fixed lugs and 20mm knockouts positioned at the top, bottom, side, and rear for versatile cable entry and exit. This ensures a secure and tidy installation for electricians. Its clean white finish perfectly complements other Hager Sollysta moulded wiring accessories.
